```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
actual <- read.csv('C:/Users/colet/Documents/GEOG5890_Capstone/data/Final_Monthly_Crash_Grid_Table/new/Complete_Grid_Monthly_Data.csv')
rf <- read.csv('./RF_Model_Denver_Grid_Predictions.csv')
gb <- read.csv('./GB_Model_Denver_Grid_Predictions.csv')
xgboost <- read.csv('./XGBoost_Model_Denver_Grid_Predictions.csv')
```

```{r}
actual <- actual %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2023, 2024))
```

```{r}
combined <- left_join(actual, rf, by = join_by(GRID_ID == GRID_ID, Year == Year,
                                   Month == Month))
```

```{r}
combined <- combined %>%
  select(-CrashCount.y) %>%
  rename(Actual_Crash_Count = CrashCount.x,
         RF_Predicted_Crashes = Predicted_Crashes)
```

```{r}
combined <- left_join(combined, gb, by = join_by(GRID_ID == GRID_ID, Year == Year,
                                   Month == Month)) %>%
  select(-CrashCount) %>%
  rename(GB_Predicted_Crashes = Predicted_Crashes)
```

```{r}
combined <- left_join(combined, xgboost, by = join_by(GRID_ID == GRID_ID,
                                                      Year == Year,
                                                      Month == Month)) %>%
  select(-CrashCount) %>%
  rename(XGB_Predicted_Crashes = Predicted_Crashes)
```

```{r}
write.csv(combined, './Combined_Results.csv')
```
